subject: Renewal: request for tokens/sec commitment & reserved GPU expansion — EchoTech
messages:
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@echotech.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, EchoTech Procurement <procurement@echotech.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal: capacity bump & tokens/sec SLA — details attached

Hi Naomi,

As we discussed last week on the call, EchoTech is preparing our renewal paperwork and we need to lock in two changes on the Dedicated deployment before signing: an immediate reserved pool expansion and a tokens-per-second (tokens/sec) throughput commitment with clear SLO language.

Summary of needs (see attached echotech_capacity_needs.xlsx for hourly profiles):
- Reserved pool: +8 x A100-equivalent GPUs (we currently have 12) to support forecasted growth in Q1/Q2.
- Throughput guarantee: 18,000 tokens/sec sustained for inference route /v1/generate (aggregated across the reserved pool) with an SLO of 99.5% measured monthly.
- Tail latency guidance: 95th percentile token latency at peak should be <= 120ms.
- Remedies: request credit-based remediation for missed monthly SLOs (simple % credit per 1% below target up to 20%).

Can you confirm if Redwood can provide firm language we can add to the renewal (we prefer an addendum) and an ETA for capacity being live if we sign on Jan 28? Procurement will want a DocuSign-ready addendum and a short technical statement of how the throughput is guaranteed (e.g., dedicated vCPU/GPU allocation, routing/fallback).

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if useful.

Sara
Sara Kim
Head of Platform Engineering, EchoTech
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@echotech.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: capacity bump & tokens/sec SLA — details attached

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear summary and the profile sheet.

We can support the requested reserved pool expansion and will draft an addendum with explicit tokens/sec SLO language. A few immediate notes and asks from our side:
- Capacity lead time: if signed by Jan 28 we can commit to having additional GPUs live by Feb 15 (provisional on procurement/PO timings and data-center schedules).
- Measured metric: we propose measuring tokens/sec aggregated across the reserved pool on a 1-minute rolling window; monthly SLO evaluation (calendar month).
- Suggested SLO: 18,000 tokens/sec sustained with 99.5% monthly attainment. We will include an incident/windowed remediation clause tied to credits (example: 5% invoice credit for monthly attainment between 99.0–99.49%, 10% if 98.0–98.99%, etc.).
- Fallbacks: the addendum will also call out automatic fallback to compatible hot spare capacity in other regions or on Redwood-hosted burst capacity; we can list throttling and queue-depth behavioral expectations.

I've attached a first-pass doc (draft-slos-tokensps-addendum-v1.docx) that contains proposed contract language plus a short technical appendix explaining routing and KV-cache constraints. 

Copying Marissa and Vivek to confirm pricing and legal redline windows. 

If that aligns, I'll convert the draft into a DocuSign-ready PDF and share the link. If you prefer to tighten the credit bands or change the window definition (e.g., 5-minute window vs 1-minute), let me know and we'll incorporate it.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 08:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal: capacity bump & tokens/sec SLA — EchoTech (internal)

Team — forwarding EchoTech request and my proposed draft. Quick items we need to finalize:
- Pricing delta for +8 A100-equivalent GPUs (on top of current committed reservation): please provide monthly and annual commit numbers, include any accelerated discount if they sign a 12-month term.
- SLO credit bands: propose we cap remediation credits at 15% for any single month; marketing/legal asked for a simple band (0.5% increments are noisy).
- Operational readiness: what is the realistic activation date if DocuSign returns within 3 business days? (Naomi: I suggested Feb 15 provisional).

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 16:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal: capacity bump & tokens/sec SLA — EchoTech (pricing + docusign)

Quick reply — pricing & next steps: 

- Pricing: +8 A100-equivalent reserved GPUs = $45,000/month incremental (with 10% discount for 12-month renewal). One-time provisioning fee $6,000.
- SLO credits: agree to a capped monthly credit up to 15% as Naomi suggested; propose these bands: >=99.5% = 0% credit; 99.0–99.49% = 5% credit; 98.0–98.99% = 10% credit; <98.0% = 15% credit.
- Activation ETA: if DocuSign is returned within 3 business days we can target Feb 12 (we can accelerate to Feb 8 with weekend provisioning at a 1.25x one-time fee).
- Legal redline: Aditya — please confirm the fallback wording (cross-region burst vs forced throttling) is acceptable.

I've turned Naomi's draft into a PDF and uploaded to DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/ECH-TokensPS-Addendum (placeholder). Attached in this thread: echotech_renewal_term_sheet.pdf (summary of financials).

If everyone signs off, Naomi can send the DocuSign link to Sara and Procurement and we'll track the HubSpot deal (link below).

—Marissa
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
